title: Vertiv reports strong first quarter 2025 results
summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE: VRT), reported first quarter 2025 net sales of $2,036 million, an increase of $397 million, or 24%, compared to first quarter 2024. Organic orders growth remained strong with TTM orders up ~20% compared to the TT...
